name: A1 Bookmarks

sources.title: A1 Bookmarks homepage - social bookmarking / business listing site
Pricing Plans - Pay as you go ₹29.99/post/month and Network Bundle ₹19.99/site/month across 123 sites

requirements: No free listing tier is published — the only plans are Pay-as-you-go ₹29.99 INR per post per month, or the Network Bundle at ₹19.99 INR per site per month (choose from 123 network sites)
Account/login required (Submit Article and Payment Ledger are member features)
Content is human-moderated under a content policy; spam and prohibited niches rejected
Payments processed in INR via Razorpay; international customers can pay via PayPal by mentioning it when contacting
preparation: Business name, website URL, phone, email, and address (listings use LocalBusiness schema)
Title and description — the service says AI crafts unique content per post, but supply clean source copy
Payment method: INR card via Razorpay, or PayPal for non-India customers
workflow: Create an account / log in on a1bookmarks.com
Use 'Submit Article' / 'Submit Story' to create the post
Pay ₹29.99 per post per month (direct charge, no subscription) — each payment keeps the post published for one month
Optionally request the Network Bundle (₹19.99/site/month across chosen network sites) via the logged-in request flow
Track charges in the 'Payment Ledger' page; approval is described as same-day for paid posts
watchFor: Not free — the catalog's freemium assumption does not hold on the public pricing page; every plan is paid per post per month

Backlinks are explicitly published with the 'sponsored' attribute — the site itself describes them as 'Google-safe branded backlinks', so do NOT expect a dofollow link despite the catalog note 'link=follow'
Listings expire if the monthly per-post payment lapses ('each payment keeps your post published for one month')
This is one node of a 123-site network of near-identical bookmark directories (bookmarkdiary.com, businessdocker.com, etc.) — link-farm character; assess SEO value accordingly
Analytics/updates are sent over WhatsApp — expect a WhatsApp contact request
countsAsLive: The submitted story/article appears as a public page on a1bookmarks.com and on the homepage story feed
unknowns: Whether any unlisted free submission path exists
Whether stopping payment removes the listing or just demotes it
Review turnaround for the 'human-moderated' check on paid posts (same-day claimed)
